playstyle: Stylish and accessible. Use some of the fastest and safest counter-hit tools in the game (Wavu), strong pokes and his sword and gun stances, Iai (IAI) and Perfumer (PRF). His key moves track poorly, so you need good timing and movement against opponents who step a lot.

stances.name: Iai Stance
stances.entry: f,f,F+2 and f,f,F+1+2 transition into it
stances.note: IAI.d+1 is a Heat Engager; IAI.4,2 and IAI.2 appear in his combos. In Heat, IAI.d+2 gets better frames (Wavu).

stances.name: Perfumer
stances.entry: F after db+1,1 and other moves
stances.note: PRF.3 is a Heat Engager; PRF.2,2 is a combo filler.

keyMoves: Fast check; 1,1,2 is his i10 punish (Wavu).
Strobing Memories: i10 high, -6 on block.
One of the fastest counter-hit tools in the game.
A safe homing CH tool (Wavu mini-combos follow CH b+4).
Llawfrodedd: i18 mid, +0 on block, Heat Engager.
To start Heat and keep the turn.
Durandal: i24 mid, +3 on block, Heat Engager.
To keep the turn and start Heat.
Asterism of Virtue: i18 mid from a run, +2 on block, launches on counter hit; enters IAI.
To close distance and keep the turn.
His i15 launch punisher (Wavu BnB starter).
Oval Cut: i15 while-standing launcher, -16 on block.
Baguette Cut: i14 while-standing mid, -8 on block, launches on counter hit.
Fine Salute: i16 low, -13 on block; turns into a throw on counter hit.
Polite Greetings: i19 high that crushes lows and tornadoes (+67a), -11 on block.
